ARITHMETIC (design 8.4; integers; every division rounds UP; one math module, unit-tested). With system_count N, s = sigma_all as a Fraction: projected_heap = heap_bytes_per_row*N; projected_fixed_index = (primary_key_bytes_per_row + weighted_index_bytes_per_row)*N; projected_tier_index = ceil(tier_index_bytes_per_row_per_unit_fraction * s * N); projected_archetype = sum; projected_search = 0 when system_search for the pinned generation is READY with a VERIFIED validation receipt (read v3_meta.derived_product), else (real_pre010_bytes_per_row + measured_010_delta_bytes_per_row)*N; then the RESUME rules per product: a resume is recognised ONLY when v3_derived.search_build_chunk / archetype_build_chunk rows exist for the pinned generation AND the product row exists with lifecycle_state BUILDING AND its manifest_sha256 equals, for Archetype, the complete receipt's expected_product_manifest_sha256 (bytes -> hex) and, for Search, the manifest the Search builder computes for this generation and checkout (scripts/v3_system_search.py product_manifest(generation), line 102); anything else pays the full projection (record why). On a recognised resume: rows_done = sum(systems) of the sealed chunk receipts; rows_left = N - rows_done; bytes_done = pg_total_relation_size of the product's physical table now (v3_derived.system_search / v3_derived.system_archetype) minus relation_total_bytes_at_start from the build-start receipt (contract: /state/search/build-start-receipt.json and /state/archetype/build-start-receipt.json, sealed JSON {schema_version ed-finder/v3-build-start-receipt/v1, product_code, derived_generation_id, manifest_sha256 hex, relation_total_bytes_at_start, started_at, f2d_operator_code_sha256}; part C writes them; when the file is absent or does not match the product/generation/manifest, bytes_done = 0 -- conservative -- and the receipt says so); fixed_left = search_fixed_bytes_per_row*rows_left or archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row*rows_left; variable_left: Search = 2 * one aggregate over the UNSEALED systems of the pinned generation -- systems whose system_rating_vector.chunk_ordinal is not in search_build_chunk -- of octet_length(s.name) + COALESCE(octet_length(gr.display_name),0) + COALESCE(octet_length(ms.main_star_class),0) joining {canonical schema}.systems, v3_vocab.galaxy_region and the is_main_star body_mechanics row exactly as scripts/v3_system_search.py lines 343-383 derive those three columns (take the canonical schema from the pinned generation's manifest canonical_schema as the builder does; validate it against the SCHEMA_NAME regex before interpolating it as an identifier via psycopg.sql.Identifier); Archetype = 2*63*rows_left; tier_left: Archetype only = tier_index_bytes_per_row_per_unit_fraction * (sum over the unsealed chunks, from the complete read's per-chunk.jsonl validated with validate_per_chunk_log against the committed receipt, of the per-key counts S+A+B (floor 60) + S+A (floor 76) + S (floor 88)) -- refuse the resume (exit 16) when the log is absent, fails validation, or lacks any unsealed chunk; remaining = fixed_left + variable_left + tier_left; projected_<product> = max(remaining, projected_<product> - bytes_done). projected_new = projected_archetype + projected_search; required_bytes = ceil(1.15 * projected_new) computed as (23*projected_new + 19) // 20. Pass iff available_bytes >= required_bytes.

RECEIPT (sealed with content_sha256 via f2d_evidence.seal; written to --output and printed on stdout): schema_version ed-finder/v3-finder-capacity-gate/v1; status passed|refused; exit_code; item results (a)-(f) each with the compared values; every input (the five evidence content_sha256 values, the step 0 fields used, both footprint receipts' per-row fields, sigma_all exact as numerator/denominator and float, N and its three sources, the volume reading); every intermediate (each projected_* term, per product: resume_recognised, rows_done, rows_left, bytes_done, fixed_left, variable_left, tier_left, remaining, term_charged and which branch of the max won); required_bytes, available_bytes, headroom_bytes; f2d_operator_code_sha256; generation identity; read_only true; db_writes_performed false. A failure receipt has the same envelope with the failing item and reason.

TESTS. tests/test_v3_finder_capacity_gate.py drives the pure functions with hand-built receipts and a fake connection where needed (the live reads go through small functions you can monkeypatch, as the complete-read tests do), covering every case design 8.4 lists: available_bytes == required_bytes passes and required_bytes - 1 refuses with exit 15; the receipt reports every input and intermediate; the committed synthetic docs/operations/evidence/2026-10-10-wide-archetype-footprint-200k.json fed in unchanged refuses with exit 14; missing or incomplete histogram (exit 12), sigma_all > 4.0 (13), a footprint receipt from a different 011 (14), insufficient space (15), absent or non-accepted decision (10), coefficients mismatch (11), archetype_model_sha256 mismatch (11), each identity mismatch of 8.3 (the complete receipt's identity, the fractions file's converter identity, each footprint receipt's identity, the attested value itself missing or malformed -> 2) -- each varied INDEPENDENTLY from an otherwise fully valid fixture so one valid field cannot mask another; resume at 90% rows and 90% bytes with matching manifest passes while the same space with a different manifest identity pays the full projection and refuses; an early saving (90% rows, 70% bytes) is charged the source-derived remainder, not 10%; a wide tail (90% of Search rows written for 50% of the projection, the unsealed 10% carrying names six times longer) is charged the measured text bytes, exceeding the projection's remaining 50%; a dense tail (90% rows and bytes, 30% of tier entries unsealed) is charged the full tier term for those entries; ceil arithmetic on non-divisible inputs; the (23x+19)//20 reserve equals ceil(1.15x) for a range of x. tests/test_v3_finder_capacity_gate_operator.py: the action's identity check precedes require_target; pinned constants; df command and docker-inspect mount resolution match the step 0 action's strings; read-only container flags; no DML in the program source (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE absent) and connection.read_only = True; the ops workflow allowlists v3-finder-capacity-gate in both the choice list and the case statement with its stage/run/upload steps; the input is validated as 64 lowercase hex. Database-backed tests are welcome through the existing archetype fixtures where cheap; runners have no PostgreSQL, so write them, run what runs, and list the rest.
